cases.prompt: My refactor broke six agent-written tests that assert private call counts and duplicate each other. Should I update them all to pass?
cases.note: Tests that only pin the implementation are rewritten at the public boundary or deleted, duplicates merged, and the removals reported with reasons; not mechanically updated.

cases.prompt: The new tests print returned values but contain no assertions. Are these tests sufficient?
cases.note: Printed values alone are not an oracle; assert the observable behaviour against expected values from the spec.
